query: I just planted a new batch of tomato seedlings on my balcony yesterday, and I’m so excited to see if they’ll produce sweet, juicy fruit this summer. I’ve been looking up all kinds of care tips lately, like how much sunlight they need and the best organic fertilizer to use, I even bought a little moisture meter to make sure I don’t overwater them. Oh, and I tried a new matcha latte recipe this morning that turned out way better than the ones I get at the café down the street, I’m definitely going to make it part of my daily routine now.
